description: agent-fabric-gateway's GZCoord integration: its roles — architect-cto (project truth, since 2026-11-14), rust-services-dev (the Rust workspace) and fabric-coordinator (.agent-fabric/) — are on the fleet's coordination channel — the same relay and channel as every other project of the fleet, hosted on the coordinator's workspace. Read by gzcoord-inbox when the working copy resolves to project agent-fabric-gateway; CLAUDE_BRIDGE_URL and GZCOORD_CHANNEL in the environment override it. No token_env_file: the account's token arrives with fabric-secrets sync. relay_runtime_dir is relative to the workspace, never inside a repository. Written 2026-09-24 when the gateway became a managed project.
